description: Read the full dimension sheet of one object: overall size, mounting holes, notes, size tables, mating features, related objects (call get_geometry on their slugs to traverse), FAQ, and every public CAD source with its license. Use it to answer how big something is, where its holes are, or what it fits. It never returns download links: use get_free_files for those, get_fits when you only need the mating features. Unknown objects return an error with a hint to search first. Objects with a planned or finished Xem scan also list paid_offers: price in USD, the page where a person can buy the files, and the x402 URL an agent can pay itself once the scan exists; this tool never charges anything.

object.description: Slug as returned by find_geometry or find_by_dimensions, e.g. '4080-aluminum-extrusion'. An exact name or alias also resolves.

name: get_geometry
title: Read one object's dimension sheet
